ALTER TABLE upwork_messages ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS replied BOOLEAN DEFAULT false;
ALTER TABLE upwork_messages ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reminded BOOLEAN DEFAULT false;

UPDATE upwork_messages SET reminded = true
WHERE replied = false AND reminded = false AND kind = 'message'
  AND created_at < now() - interval '2 hours'
  AND created_at > now() - interval '3 days'
RETURNING id, client, job_title, text_ru, created_at;

WITH w AS (SELECT now() - interval '7 days' AS since)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM upwork_jobs, w WHERE created_at > since) AS jobs_new,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM upwork_jobs, w WHERE created_at > since AND score >= 6) AS jobs_good,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM upwork_jobs, w WHERE created_at > since AND status = 'taken') AS jobs_taken,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM upwork_jobs, w WHERE created_at > since AND status = 'skipped') AS jobs_skipped,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM upwork_messages, w WHERE created_at > since AND kind = 'message') AS msgs,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT client) FROM upwork_messages, w WHERE created_at > since AND kind = 'message') AS clients,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM upwork_messages, w WHERE created_at > since AND kind = 'offer') AS offers,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM upwork_tasks, w WHERE finished_at > since AND status = 'done' AND revision_of IS NULL) AS projects_done,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM upwork_tasks, w WHERE finished_at > since AND revision_of IS NOT NULL) AS revisions,
  (SELECT round(avg(review_score), 1) FROM upwork_tasks, w WHERE finished_at > since AND review_score IS NOT NULL) AS avg_review,
  (SELECT string_agg(skills, ',') FROM upwork_jobs, w WHERE created_at > since AND status = 'taken') AS taken_skills,
  (SELECT string_agg(skills, ',') FROM upwork_jobs, w WHERE created_at > since AND score >= 6) AS good_skills;
